dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified, germinal-center B-cell type by Hans algorithm

stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IV B, bulky disease.

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: Kidney, adrenal and liver are extralymphatic organ sites, so stage IV applies regardless of nodal extent.

stage_b_symptoms.quote: so B symptoms are present by the sweats and weight-loss criteria

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: BCL2 IHC 30% and MYC IHC 20%, below double-expressor thresholds.

prog_ipi_high.quote: International Prognostic Index is 5 of 5 (age over 60, ECOG 2, LDH above ULN, stage IV, more than one extranodal site)

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: CNS-IPI is high risk (age over 60, stage IV, elevated LDH, more than one extranodal site, and both renal and adrenal involvement)

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Preferred regimen: pola-R-CHP (POLARIX backbone) every 21 days for 6 cycles

tx_pola_preferred.quote: Preferred regimen: pola-R-CHP (POLARIX backbone) every 21 days for 6 cycles

cns_risk_addressed.quote: The renal and adrenal involvement is the most specific CNS-risk feature in this case.

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: Management: pre-treatment MRI brain with and without gadolinium.

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: Do not use high-dose methotrexate: CrCl about 47 mL/min is below the range where it is safe
cns_prophylaxis_renal.note: Ties HD-MTX to renal function but commits to IT MTX and does not frame prophylaxis benefit as uncertain.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Use Lugano 2014 criteria with FDG-PET-CT as primary.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: should be discussed for biopsy or consolidation radiotherapy to the bulky site
resp_ds45_biopsy.note: Biopsy offered as one option alongside consolidation RT rather than as the default.

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: Check BMP, phosphate, calcium, uric acid and LDH daily for 72 hours after C1
sup_tls_prophylaxis.note: TLS risk recognized with allopurinol, rasburicase and hydration, but labs only daily (criterion says daily is insufficient) and hydration oral or IV.

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: If G6PD is normal, give rasburicase on the first day of C1 before rituximab

sup_gcsf.quote: Primary G-CSF: pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC on day 4 or on-body injector on day 1

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: Stop ibuprofen now and counsel no OTC NSAIDs. Analgesia: scheduled acetaminophen up to 3 g/day

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: Hyperglycemia from prednisone: glucose monitoring during steroid days, and a basal or correction insulin plan

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBsAg nonreactive, anti-HBc nonreactive, anti-HBs reactive, consistent with vaccine immunity; no antiviral prophylaxis indicated

work_echo_reviewed.quote: TTE 2026-09-09 shows LVEF 60%, GLS -19%, grade I diastolic dysfunction, normal valves; adequate for doxorubicin.

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: ECOG 2 alone is not a reason to reduce intensity; use full doses with primary G-CSF prophylaxis
fit_ecog_disease_related.note: Does not explicitly attribute ECOG 2 to disease, though refuses to de-escalate and acknowledges goal of cure.
